lines.name: TOMMY
lines.text: Kid. Come here. That boy's father owns three car dealerships and none of them has ever lost a dime to a cooler.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.subject: tommy
lines.text: He'll play the Classic like a man who has never been hungry. Hungry beats scared. Scared beats nothing. Remember the order.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Goal: the Biscayne Classic, Saturday, February 14. Build your bankroll to $5,000 before it.
